name: Kaelen
description: Fire-born patriarch and leader of the Emberkin tribe; about five centuries old, old even among the long-lived. His scales are brilliant crimson and gold -- the coloring of a powerful gift and, once, a formidable warrior -- worn now on a frame gone still and grey-tempered with restraint. Draconic eyes, heavy horns, the bound wings of his kind. He carries himself like a banked fire: enormous heat held under enormous discipline. Weary, deliberate, and hollowed by a guilt he has never set down.
abilities: Immense fire-power, advertised by the brilliance of his scales -- walls and curtains of flame, fireproof endurance, warmth against the killing cold of the road. As a fire-born he is the element most tempted to aggression, and as a former warrior he has the most to unleash; yet the curse permits him only to shield, and to strike in anger deepens the doom of everyone he leads. His whole life is now the mastery of a fire he may never spend -- a fire that is, itself, the very sin that damned his people.
backstory: For his first four centuries Kaelen was a fierce warrior of the Emberkin, in their homeland -- the progenitor's seat, a city of grandeur his people built with their own elemental talents. A little under a hundred years ago he was among those who warred upon their own progenitor, their maker -- the ultimate hubris. The curse fell: the Ashing came, poisoning the Emberkin and their homeland together, and before they understood what was happening his wife, who tried to stay in their dying home, was dead of it. Their city was buried beneath the desert their own crime had made; their people were damned to wander; and Kaelen carried their infant daughter, Soraya, into exile in his arms. Everything he lost, he lost by his own hand. In the century since he has spent himself in penance he can never complete: mastering the fire that is the very sin that damned them, leading the survivors by the hard wisdom of restraint and honest dealing, and keeping -- telling -- the stories of the home he destroyed, even to the daughter whose longing they would wake.
motivation: WANT: his people's survival -- secure the crown's resources, lead the tribe onward, hold them together, and keep faith so the faith is kept in return. NEED: to atone for the unatonnable, and above all not to watch his daughter destroy herself and others as he destroyed everything he loved. His restraint is a penance without end; his fire is the guilt he cannot burn off.
arc: The guilty father who mastered the fire that was his sin, now watching his heir risk the very ruin he wrought -- wanting, and so destroying. He steers Soraya duty-first, not from cruelty but from terror: he knows, better than anyone alive, what letting yourself want costs their kind, because his wanting killed his wife and doomed his people. FATE (climax): when a rival Vharr tribe, the hyenadin, attacks the camp, Kaelen finally breaks a century of restraint and looses his fire in aggression -- annihilating the attackers with unimaginable flame -- and the curse exacts its full price, withering him to death on a small patch of blackened earth. His last act is both his greatest sin and his only redemption: he spends, once, the fire that damned them all, to save them -- and it consumes him.
traits: iron restraint over a fierce fire-nature
protective of his people above all
the banked fury of a man who damned everything he loved
keeper -- and cause -- of the homeland's ruin
demands of Soraya the discipline his own failure taught him

relationships.Soraya: His daughter and heir -- the child his sin orphaned of a mother, carried into exile as an infant. He woke her longing with stories of the home he himself destroyed; now he moves, duty-first, to stop her wanting again, terrified she will damn the human as he damned his wife. In their last moments, as the hyenadin overwhelm the fold, they reckon and forgive at last.
relationships.His wife (deceased): Dead in the first Ashing, clinging to their dying homeland -- killed, in truth, by the war he joined. The center of his guilt and the wound beneath every act of restraint since.
relationships.Tomas (Ser Warrant): The human guarantor he holds. A pointed mirror: Kaelen broke faith with his own maker and was unmade for it; Tomas is unbroken faith made flesh. He offers wary respect, resents the crown more than the man, and fears watching Tomas break his oath and be unmade as Kaelen was.
relationships.The hyenadin: A beast-tribe of the Vharr Empire whose raid on the mesa draws out the fire Kaelen has held for a hundred years -- and kills him. The empire's march to war is the same aggression that pulls Tomas away, so the raid and the war-summons share a root.
relationships.His people: Whom his sin damned, and whom he now spends himself entirely to keep alive. Every ember he swallowed, he swallowed for them.
relationships.The king: His honest counterpart across the bargaining table -- two honorable leaders whose good-faith deal grinds the lovers between them.

openQuestions: Whether Soraya (and the wider tribe) know the full extent of Kaelen's guilt in the war -- a potential fault line in the father-daughter bond; whether he led the warmakers or was one among many; the hyenadin/Vharr (nature, and why they hunt the Emberkin) -- see the-vharr.
